options.tracking: Now tracking (on the day of the flight)

add_flight.name: Add flight
add_flight.description: Track a flight on a given day. Several flights of one trip can be added at once.

date.name: Date
date.description: Departure date, local to the departure airport.

who.name: Who
who.description: Optional name, e.g. Tony, so alerts read "Tony's flight".

from.name: From
from.description: Optional airport code where they get on, for a flight with several stops. Several flights: applies to the first.

to.name: To
to.description: Optional airport code where they get off. Several flights: applies to the last. Without it, tracking stops before the route doubles back.

remove_flight.name: Remove flight
remove_flight.description: Stop tracking or drop an upcoming flight (ids from the Tracked flights sensor).

lookup_flight.name: Look up flight
lookup_flight.description: Every leg the flight(s) fly that day, to choose From/To before adding.

flight.name: Flight
flight.description: Flight number(s), as for Add flight.

date.name: Date
date.description: Departure date, local to the departure airport.
